framework: R1-R10 retained; each requirement specialised for an inference / re-analysis study

requirements.title: Documented scientific authorization
requirements.demand: Named, dated, attributable authorisation with scope, population, seeds and exclusions.
requirements.inference_specialisation: Identical. Scope must enumerate: arms A0/A1/A8 only, population ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT, mode RE_ANALYSIS_ONLY, and the exclusion list.

requirements.title: Frozen protocol and frozen population
requirements.demand: Freeze the training recipe and the populations by digest before the first training step.
requirements.inference_specialisation: No training recipe exists. Substitute frozen inputs: (a) four component checkpoint SHA-256; (b) frozen ROI/fusion/threshold config (0.30 / 1.50 / 256 / 0.50 / 0.50); (c) frozen membership artifact C8_lambda0.25_budget0.25.csv with its SHA and selected_ids_sha256; (d) manifest digests for DEV and (if approved) VAL808; (e) exact row-count and sample_id-set equality checks at load.
requirements.training_only_na_reason: No optimiser, loss, augmentation, LR, batch size, epoch ceiling or patience exists in a re-analysis; freezing a training recipe would be meaningless.

requirements.title: Direct source-to-authority field comparison
requirements.demand: At least one edge must read the frozen authority and compare a concrete value.
requirements.inference_specialisation: Compare the harness's effective constants against the frozen authority VALUES, field by field: roi_proposal_threshold 0.30, roi_expansion 1.50, roi_resolution 256, segmentation_output_threshold 0.50, safety_accept_threshold 0.50, budget 0.25, K 1239, lambda 0.25, bootstrap 2000 / seed 42. Plus a second authority edge: recompute the A0/A1/A7/A8 aggregates and compare them to the frozen Phase-28 table 02 values (this is a VALUE comparison, not a digest comparison).

requirements.title: Exact harness SHA binding
requirements.demand: The digest of the executing harness must be recorded and re-verified at launch.
requirements.inference_specialisation: Identical and non-negotiable: the re-analysis harness computes its own raw-byte SHA-256 at start, compares it to the authorised digest, aborts on mismatch, and writes the digest into every per-arm registry entry.

requirements.title: Parameter-count checks
requirements.demand: Measure total and trainable parameter counts and compare to declared expectations.
requirements.inference_specialisation: No training, so 'trainable' is meaningless. Substitute INFERENCE_LOAD_VERIFICATION: at load, verify each state_dict's tensor count and summed numel against declared values (G 3,523,001; R_psi 1,276,401; B_phi 36,801; S_omega 1,217) and require 0 missing / 0 unexpected keys. If BARR-M1 runs purely on frozen per-case arrays (no model load at all), this becomes a NEGATIVE requirement: assert that NO model was constructed and that the parameter counters are exactly 0.
requirements.training_only_na_reason: Gradient/optimiser state does not exist in a frozen inference or re-analysis path.

requirements.title: Prespecified seed policy
requirements.demand: Declare the seed set and what claim the count supports before launch.
requirements.inference_specialisation: Training seeds are not applicable. Substitute: (a) declare that inference is deterministic and that NO inference RNG is consumed; (b) fix the bootstrap seed at 42 with 2000 resamples; (c) declare explicitly that BARR-M1 provides ONE frozen bundle and therefore no seed-to-seed uncertainty; (d) declare that the Phase-29 three-seed spread is NOT a BARR-M1 uncertainty estimate.
requirements.training_only_na_reason: There are no training seeds in a re-analysis over a single frozen bundle.

requirements.title: Checkpoint and complete epoch-log persistence
requirements.demand: Persist per-epoch logs plus latest.pt / best.pt with correct selection metadata.
requirements.inference_specialisation: No epochs and no checkpoints are produced. Substitute: (a) per-case output persistence for every arm (sample_id, dice_global, dice_arm, delta, executed flag, safety decision) so harm is independently recomputable; (b) write-once outputs (O_CREAT|O_EXCL) with post-write size and SHA verification; (c) a resume manifest making each arm idempotent; (d) a per-arm completion marker that records the exact input SHAs consumed.
requirements.training_only_na_reason: A re-analysis has no epoch loop, no early stopping and no checkpoint selection.

requirements.title: Positive and negative gate controls
requirements.demand: Demonstrate the gate FAILS when it should.
requirements.inference_specialisation: Identical plus inference-specific negative controls: corrupt a component SHA; swap the A8 membership artifact for C7; drop one case; duplicate one case; change K from 1239 to 1238; shuffle case order and assert per-case output stability; point the population at VAL808 while the contract says DEV. Each must abort with its named code. A pass-through on any negative case is a release blocker.

requirements.title: Separated development-validation and independent-evidence claim boundary
requirements.demand: State which population each metric uses and what claim it can support.
requirements.inference_specialisation: Identical, and stricter here: the primary population is the TRAINING population of B_phi and S_omega and a subset of TRAIN for G and R_psi. The claim boundary must record `DESCRIPTIVE_DEV`, `IN_SAMPLE_FOR_ROUTER_AND_SAFETY = true`, and prohibit HELD_OUT, CONFIRMATORY, GENERALISATION and CLINICAL_SAFETY.

requirements.title: No protected TEST access, no unapproved external inference
requirements.demand: TEST is Phase39-only; ROUTER_HOLDOUT is locked; external inference needs approval.
requirements.inference_specialisation: Identical, and additionally: enumerate every file opened, abort on any path matching TEST / ROUTER_HOLDOUT / external markers, and require read counters to be zero before launch and zero at completion.

release_rule: All ten must be PASS and the negative-control battery green before launch.
